events.title: Stone Rebellion Demo Is Live for Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Steam Next Fest started yesterday, and the Stone Rebellion demo is out there! First, thank you. Seeing people jump in and start rebuilding their villages has been a joy for us. If you haven't tried it yet, there's still time. The demo is free, and it only takes a few minutes to see whether it's for you. The world fell, but the golems endure. Now it's time to fight back. events.title: The Stone Rebellion demo is out: survive ten nights
events.summary: A handful of golems escaped the Machine with one stolen crystal and set it in a lost city nobody has counted yet. Build by day. When the dark comes, hold the Town Hall. Survive ten nights.What's in the demoA complete ten-night run in Hollow Vale, in three acts: the beasts of the barren ring (nights 1–4), the Machine's Overseers (nights 5–9), and the Reclaimer on night 10.A new map every run. events.title: Stone Rebellion Playtest #1 Has Closed, Thank You!
events.summary: That's a wrap: the Stone Rebellion playtest is officially closed!This week meant a lot to me. Watching people actually settle into the game, raise their golems, survive the nights, and come back with thoughts, that's exactly what this stage was for. events.title: Stone Rebellion Playtest Is Live!
events.summary: I'm really happy to share that the Stone Rebellion playtest is officially open, which means you can play it right now!This has been a solo project for a while now: building a survival city-builder where escaped stone golems carry a stolen Crystal of Life, raising a settlement by day and defending it in grid-based battles by night.
